---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[feature] "
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: []
---

## Summary
A concise description of the requested feature.

## Motivation / Use case
Why is this feature needed? Who will benefit?

## Proposed solution
How would you implement it? Include high-level design or sketches.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Behavior is defined clearly
- [ ] Tests or e2e scenarios where applicable
- [ ] Documentation updated

## Alternatives considered
Explain other options you considered and why you rejected them.

## Additional context
Any other context, screenshots, or related issues.

---

## Contributor checklist (please check before submitting)
- [ ] I searched existing issues and PRs and this is not already requested
- Frontend checks (if applicable)
  - [ ] I ran `pnpm check`
  - [ ] I ran `pnpm lint`
- Backend (Rust) checks (if applicable)
  - [ ] I ran `cargo fmt`
  - [ ] I ran `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`
- Localization
  - [ ] UI text will use `* as m` paraglide messages (no hardcoded strings)

Maintainers: add labels and link to relevant milestones if appropriate.
